basis: Provisional nominal USD engineering estimates for accepted November revision. Unchanged component/labor/energy/RAM rates explicitly carried forward from June 15; no claimed November vendor quotes. Capital, design/mask NRE and marketing excluded.
graphics_area_basis: 100 mm2 June line/blit controller plus 12 mm2 planning allowance for inherited mode/sprite/palette compatibility; retain 3 um, .72 new-part maturity and existing package assumption. Not measured silicon area.
monitor_basis: $230 analog HD17H-class OEM core includes its linear amplifier (June core allowance was $210); $9 covers intensity DAC and level matching, replacing the $20 separate amplifier/DAC allowance. Existing $25 deflection adaptation remains, with qualification pending; no duplicate amplifier charge.
routing: Professional card 1.5 h, 2.2 kWh, $1.75 baseline consumables; monitor 2.5 h, 9 kWh, $3 baseline consumables. Common model applies its 1982 overhead factor to consumables. No prior-year assembly learning on either revision.
autocad_price_basis: Historical original US list price $1000; scenario Artemis licence planning anchor, not a negotiated contract. Vendor costs and channel split unspecified.
